name: pkmnscan-app
_comment_eslint: eslint is held at ^9 while 10 is current, and the config carries two rules and no shared preset. Both choices are argued in the header of app/eslint.config.js, beside the rules themselves — not restated here, because the version and the reason drift apart the moment they live in two files. The `lint` script carries no --fix and must not gain one: `make check` runs it, and D18 keeps anything that writes off the path that decides whether work is done.
_comment_playwright: @playwright/test is pinned exactly, not caret-ranged. scripts/screenshot.sh pins the same version for its render, and two Playwright versions in one repo means two browser downloads and two behaviours. Bump both together or neither. 1.58.0 is the FLOOR for one named problem (D129): through 1.57 a spec loaded as ESM — this package is `type: module` — has its `test.location` reported short under Node 23+ (the rig's Homebrew Node is 25), so `.serve/design-check.json` pointed a session 35 lines into the wrong test; 1.58.0 is the first release that counts it right in that shape (1.56 already did for CommonJS, which is not this repo) and was proven on the full suite and `make verdict-selftest` under Node 25 before it was taken. Not the latest, by the rule that a bump moves to the first version that fixes the named problem. 1.55.1 before it was the same rule: GHSA-7mvr-c777-76hp, browsers downloaded without verifying the SSL certificate, fixed in .1.
